verdicts.reason: A scrambles the title into 'MAKEUP TRAVEL … KIT': MAKEUP comes before TRAVEL, the first two words are tiny side-by-side pills far from KIT, and a big dead gap sits between them. On top of that, a visible lighter background band cuts across the middle, and most of the makeup imagery from the original is gone. B keeps the TRAVEL/MAKEUP/KIT stack in order and at a readable size, but it shares the same mismatched background band. Its KIT bar runs edge to edge and is taller than the other two, which breaks the series of matching pills, and MAKEUP sits off-centre in its bar.
